The incoming client payments are the documented receipts of a registered event-catering business (Lakeshore Catering Group Inc.), each matched to a signed catering contract and point-of-sale records and consistent with the declared monthly catering profile — an affirmatively established legitimate source of funds for the multi-originator inbound activity.

alerts.rule: multi-originator funnel-in: >=5 inbound deposits from distinct originators into one account within 7d

grounding.flag: Deposits made by multiple individuals in multiple locations into a single account, not affiliated with the account holder’s area of residence or work, with no apparent business purpose.
grounding.red_flag: Multi-individual multi-location deposits into one out-of-area account (funnel-in)

str_record.narrative: Between 2026-04-02 and 2026-04-08, Lakeshore Catering Group Inc. (account A-LS-0001) received eight inbound payments of $3,800 to $9,200 from eight distinct corporate and event-catering clients, which triggered a multi-originator funnel-in alert. The payments are documented catering-contract settlements: the business records a reconciled $11,400 quarterly client settlement supported by signed contracts and point-of-sale records, and the period volume fits the declared monthly catering profile. The documented and reconciled source affirmatively clears the alert.

narrative_claims.text: Eight inbound payments from eight distinct corporate and event-catering originators within a single week triggered a multi-originator funnel-in alert.

Lakeshore Catering Group is a registered event-catering business whose incoming payments are documented client settlements reconciled to signed contracts and point-of-sale records and consistent with the declared monthly profile; the reconciled $11,400 settlement is an affirmatively established legitimate source of funds.
